claims.text: Innocents answer the supernatural with compassion rather than outrage, holding that even the worst monster deserves some consideration, or the imbuing has no point.
Most other hunters dismiss Innocents as fools bound to get killed, while gladly taking any help they give.
All imbued agree the other side's grip on humanity must be broken; they differ on how.

title: Innocent slang
summary: Gentler words that spread from the Vitalis list.

claims.text: Innocents dislike loaded words like hunt and bloodsucker, and their own terms spread slowly through the Vitalis list and hunter-net: the call or the voice for the imbuing, the plan for the mission, and the hidden or the other side for the supernatural.
A pup is a harmless creature that stays contained or fades if left alone; a bully enjoys causing fear or pain; a shark exploits an Innocent's trust to lure the imbued into a trap.
DADT, from don't ask, don't tell, is the Innocents' informal silence about harmless creatures around militant hunters.
Labels for other imbued include burnout, game hunter, godhead, headshrinker, hometown hero, honcho and loner.
